messages:
alex_a: Heads up 12 Sylvan Health RFP dropped. Key new asks: EU-only residency, HSM BYOK, model explainability table, and a retention max of 30 days. They want the full RFI + capability matrix + POC plan by next Wed. Link: https://drive.google.com/sylvan/rfp_latest

priya_s: Copy. Can we offer both Hosted-with-BYOK and Dedicated (on-prem/private) options? Need to map lead times for HSM cert and legal addenda.

josh_se: I9ll take matrix & perf targets. Will call out: latency SLOs (p50/p95), throughput (QPS), KV cache behavior, and supported quantization levels.

lina_sec: Security thread: they require HSM attestation, KMS key-export prohibition, FIPS 140-2/3 proof, and a signed subprocessor list. Also asking for dataflow diagram showing where logs live and retention controls. I9ll start the questionnaire.

legalbot: Note: BYOK + HSM broker requires additional Addendum A (security appendix). Typical turnaround 10 business days for amendments.

alex_a: POC scenario they want: 2-week functional + 2-week perf at sustained 1000 qps for embedding/rerank flows. They asked for a minimal air-gapped connector demo if Dedicated chosen.

josh_se: Draft POC plan (high-level):
```
Day 0: Kickoff, NDA & DPA confirmed
Week 1: Network setup (EU VPC peering), BYOK exchange + HSM attestation
Week 2: Integration tests (sample corpus, embedding accuracy)
Week 3: Perf ramp to target, KV cache tuning
Week 4: Scale run & results + handoff
```
Will post to sheet: https://sheets.redwood/sylvan-cap-matrix (tab: POC + matrix).

priya_s: Pricing sketch for POC (estimate, mark as draft): Hosted+BYOK: $0.0010/token gen, Embeds $0.0025/1k. Dedicated (2-week reserved): $12k flat + overage. EU isolation +15%.

lina_sec: Also they asked for proof of automated PII redaction and opt-out hooks. We need to show retention APIs and a sample audit-log entry. Josh, can you attach a redacted log sample?

josh_se: Yep. Uploading redacted audit snippet and architecture diagram (KMS -> HSM -> runtime) to the sheet by EOD. Note: on-prem HSM broker requires infrastructure engineer sign-off.

alex_a: Owners: josh = matrix + attachments, lina = security questionnaire + control mappings, priya = pricing appendix & commercial options, salesops = SOW/POC statement template. Legalbot to queue addendum.

salesops: SOW template: /assets/sow-templates/sow_poc_eu_v2.docx. I9ll prefill timeline and deliverables after we lock the POC scope.

lina_sec: Outstanding blockers: HSM attestation doc, FIPS cert, export control clause, and certificate of insurance. Marking these as blockers in the sheet.

alex_a: OK let's aim to have a consolidated package by Tue COB so legal can finish addendum. Quick sync in 2 hours if anyone needs to triage. Ping me if blocked. :eyes:
